stages.blurb: Play the opening chapters, grab the easy early trophies, and protect the one missable meditation in Chapter 1.
stages.name: Story: Chapters 1-2

stages.blurb: Keep pushing the story and finish the side-character mission strands as they appear.
stages.name: Story: Chapters 3-4

stages.blurb: Finish the final mission, then work the 100% completion checklist that unlocks after the credits.
stages.name: Story finale & 100%

stages.blurb: Sweep Leonida for cards, WAiNK spots, vehicles, and every corner of the map.
stages.name: Exploration & collectibles

stages.blurb: Stunts, races, shooting ranges, and robberies — the loud half of the list.
stages.name: Combat & driving

stages.blurb: Launder marked bills, spend big in shops, and buy every garage.
stages.name: Money & properties

stages.blurb: Mop up the last odd one-offs, then the platinum pops.
stages.name: Cleanup to platinum

trophies.guide: This is the platinum, so there is no shortcut: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Keep this tracker open while you play and clear the list stage by stage. When the last bronze, silver, or gold pops, this one follows automatically.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is one of the first trophies you will ever earn in GTA VI. Just play the mission through to its end and the trophy pops when the mission completes. It cannot be missed — it is part of the main story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and this trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. While you are still in Chapter 1, make sure you also meditate at the Chapter 1 meditation spot — that one spot can be missed, and it feeds the Positive Mental Attitude trophy. There is no mission replay in GTA VI, so do it before the chapter ends.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2's story missions in order and the trophy pops when the chapter wraps up. Side activities are optional here — the chapter trophy only cares about the main story. If you want a smoother run later, use this chapter to start scanning vehicles and studying animals with the binoculars whenever you pass them.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish all of Chapter 3's story missions and this bronze is yours when the chapter ends. By now the map is opening up, so it is worth detouring for collectibles and activities between missions. Nothing in this chapter is missable, so play at your own pace.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Complete every story mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. You are one chapter from the finale now, so it is a good moment to check which side-character strands are still open. Everything left over can still be finished in free roam after the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: This gold trophy is for finishing the last story mission of the game. There is no difficulty setting in GTA VI, so the mission plays the same for everyone — just see the story through to the credits. After it pops, the 100% completion checklist opens up and free roam continues.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission, so this trophy unlocks automatically when you finish it. Keep following the main story markers and it will come up on its own. Like all story-mission trophies, it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story mission, so play through it to the end and the trophy unlocks when the mission completes. Heist missions tend to be longer than regular ones, so stock up on ammo and armor before you start. It unlocks automatically — no extra objective needed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission that unlocks as you work through the main story. Finish the mission and the trophy pops right away. There is nothing extra to do — just follow the mission through to its conclusion.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission, so this trophy comes naturally from playing the main story. Complete the mission and it unlocks on the spot. No special conditions apply — it is unmissable.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission set around the airport, so it unlocks when you finish the mission. Expect a loud set piece — bring a fast car and a good weapon loadout. The trophy is automatic once the mission is complete.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission, so just play it through to the end. It is one of the bigger late-story missions, so take your time with the combat sections. The trophy unlocks automatically when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: This is the hardest trophy in the game, but the bar is friendlier than it sounds: the 100% checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) only appears after the story, yet everything you did during the story already counts toward it. PowerPyx notes the checklist is really closer to 60% of true game completion — you need 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, and 100 of 255 animals studied, so you can skip the hardest bits. Work through the checklist in free roam after the credits and the gold pops at 100%.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 stunts across Leonida — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights, and base jumps all count. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in total, so you have plenty of room to pick the easy ones and skip the fiddly ones. The 100% checklist wants 300, so you will likely finish this trophy while working toward A Long Road anyway.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types scattered across Leonida — things like bowling, fishing, racing, and the arcade. You only need to try each one once, not win or master it, so just sample everything as you come across it. A good habit is to try any new activity the moment you spot its icon on the map.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Head to a shooting range and earn a gold medal in every one of its challenges — PowerPyx counts 42 in total. Take it one weapon type at a time and learn each challenge's scoring before going for gold. The medals are not too hard once you know the target layout, so this is more patience than skill.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun drone races are scattered around Leonida — PowerPyx lists 14 locations. You need to win at least one race at every single location, so work through them one by one. Learn each course's corners before pushing for the win, and retrying is free, so there is no pressure.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races anywhere in Leonida — street races, off-road, whatever you enjoy most. Each race only counts once, so you need variety, not repeats of the same easy one. Start with the shorter circuits to build a quick lead, then branch out to the longer ones.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal and take him on in a fishing challenge, then out-fish him to win. Fishing is one of the calmer activities in the game, so this is a nice breather between story missions. The trophy pops as soon as you beat his score in the challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Walk into any arcade in Leonida, pick a machine, and play it through to the end. You do not need a high score — just finishing one arcade game is enough. It is a quick trophy, so grab it the first time you pass an arcade.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is one of the side characters with his own mission strand. Play through his missions as they appear and finish the last one to unlock this trophy. Side-character strands can be done after the story too, so do not worry if you leave him for later.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton has his own strand of side missions. Work through them in order and finish the final one to earn this trophy. Like the other character strands, it stays available in free roam after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's mission strand ends with a final mission that unlocks this trophy when completed. Follow his marker whenever it appears on the map and clear his missions one by one. It can be finished after the story in free roam.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Leonida is full of strangers with their own little quest lines — you need to finish 8 full strands. PowerPyx notes that only some side questlines count, and the exact list is still being confirmed, so do more than 8 strands to be safe. Strangers and Freaks is not part of the 100% checklist, so set aside time for it after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's strand of side missions ends with a final mission that unlocks this trophy. Keep an eye out for his marker and work through his jobs in order. It is available in free roam after the story, so it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone has his own mission strand, and finishing his final mission earns this trophy. Play his missions as they show up and the trophy pops at the end of the last one. Like the other character strands, it can be completed after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: This is the ONE missable trophy in the whole game, so read this carefully. There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and the first one is offered in Chapter 1 — at Jason's house and on Lucia's balcony the morning after Down to Earth — and it becomes permanently unavailable once Chapter 1 ends. Do every meditation spot as soon as it appears, keep a separate Chapter 1 save file as insurance, and remember there is no mission replay and no New Game+ to go back with. Do not use cheats during your trophy run either, because cheats disable trophies. If you meditate everywhere, this bronze pops with the last spot.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret asks you to hunt a unique animal somewhere in Leonida's wild areas. Track it down with the binoculars first — studying animals is useful for the 100% checklist too — then take the shot when you have a clear line. The trophy unlocks when the hunt for Bret is complete.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden all over Leonida, and a full set means every card in that set. You need 3 complete sets for this silver, so pick up cards whenever you spot them and keep a checklist of which sets are close to done. Cards only partly count toward 100%, so you can focus on the easiest sets first.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It is a tagging activity you can do at spots all over the map — you need 100 locations in total. Treat it like a sightseeing tour: hit the WAiNK spots whenever you are already in the area for another trophy. It is a grind, but every spot counts permanently, so steady progress adds up fast.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Challenges are small feats scattered through the game — driving, combat, exploration, and more. You need 50 of the 80 total, so skip the ones that look painful and clear the easy ones first. Most of them complete naturally while you chase other trophies, and the 100% checklist only needs 70, so this one should pop along the way.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Grab a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. The easiest way is to cause chaos in a quiet area, then break line of sight and hide until the stars fade. Make sure your partner stays with you the whole time — the trophy needs both of you to escape together.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the trick is to keep the heat on the whole time. Pick 3 shops close together, plan a fast route between them, and keep a getaway car ready. If the stars drop to zero between robberies, the chain breaks and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Drive or scan 100 different vehicles across Leonida. The 100% checklist only needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so this trophy is a natural milestone on the way there. Hop into anything new you see and use the binoculars or camera to log vehicles you cannot drive.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode — activate it during a busy firefight and drop 5 enemies before it runs out. Pick a spot with plenty of enemies grouped together, like a gang hideout, and line up your shots before you trigger it. One clean run is all it takes.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Head to Vice City International Airport, grab a plane, and take off without waiting for clearance — an unscheduled departure, in other words. Expect the police to notice quickly, so climb fast and get out of the airport airspace. The trophy pops once you are airborne and away.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Rhinos are the military tanks of Leonida, and this trophy is about getting up close with them. Push your wanted level high enough for the army to roll in, then survive the encounter with a Rhino. Bring sticky bombs or a rocket launcher and keep moving — a tank shell ends the fun fast.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean without ever being spotted — no alarms, no witnesses calling the cops. Case the store first, go in quiet, and move fast once you start grabbing. If anyone spots you, leave and try again another day; the trophy only counts a fully undetected job.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 different bank vaults and escape cleanly each time. Bank jobs are bigger than shop robberies, so plan each one: a fast car parked nearby, an escape route, and enough firepower to hold off the response. The counter tracks all 5, so you can spread them across your playthrough.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks cruise the roads of Leonida — ambush one, crack it open, and escape with the cash. Block the road ahead so the truck has to stop, then grab the money and lose the cops. One successful job is all this trophy needs.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit every named area of Leonida, from the beaches of Vice City to the swamps and small towns inland. The map fills in as you travel, so this trophy rewards just driving around and seeing the state. Check the map for grey, unexplored corners and sweep them up during your collectible runs.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Every gang in Leonida runs illegal operations — front businesses, stashes, and rackets. Rob one operation from each gang to earn this trophy. Learn which gang controls which turf first, then hit their operations one gang at a time.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach in Vice City, find a bar with a view of the water, and order a cocktail. This is one of the easiest trophies in the game — a pure vibes trophy. Sit back, watch the ocean, and let it pop.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive into a vehicle showroom and smash your way back out through the glass in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom with a big front window, build up speed inside, and burst straight through it. The trophy pops the moment you break out.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the bowling alley run by Kolt & Associates and play a game of bowling. You just need to follow through and finish a game — no strike or high score required. It is a quick, relaxing trophy to grab early.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: This one is about Jason and Lucia as a team — build up the partnership until it catches the public's eye. Keep playing the story and doing activities together as the duo, and the trophy pops when the partnership hits its moment. It comes naturally if you keep both characters active.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: GTA VI tracks the choices you make as Jason and Lucia — big decisions and small ones alike. There is no single trick here: keep playing, keep choosing, and the trophy pops once you have made enough choices across the story. It is a natural cleanup trophy for the end of a playthrough.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: As the description hints, this trophy is about succeeding on a second try — fail at something first, then nail it on the retry. It is the kind of trophy that pops on its own while you play, usually during a tricky mission or activity. If it has not popped by the end of the story, retry any activity you failed once and finish it clean.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Something strange is out there in Leonida, and this trophy is for stumbling into it. Keep your eyes open while exploring — odd encounters and unexplained sights are usually hiding off the beaten path, away from the main roads. The trophy pops the moment you witness the weird event.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by means swinging a melee weapon from a moving vehicle — line up a pedestrian and bowl them over as you drive past. Use a slow car on a quiet street so you can aim the swing properly. One clean hit is all it takes.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills are dirty cash you pick up from robberies and jobs — take them to your contacts to launder them into clean money. You need $250,000 laundered in total, so keep robbing and keep washing the cash through your contacts. The counter is cumulative, so it adds up across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, cars, food, all of it counts. By the late game you will have spent a good chunk of this naturally on gear and vehicles. If you are short at the end, buy the most expensive items you still want and the trophy pops at $100,000.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy every garage property for sale across Leonida. Garages give you somewhere to store the vehicles you collect, so they are worth owning anyway. Save up, visit each garage's sale marker, and buy them all — the trophy pops with the last purchase.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is the in-game app for registering vehicles — open it and register 10 different vehicles you own or find. Any 10 vehicles count, so use the cheapest or most common ones you come across. The trophy pops once the tenth vehicle is registered.
trophies.name: On the Spot
